note: Alley from the gate north between Block B (west) and Block A_S/A_W (east). A stands ~1.3 m lower: a lower walkway along its west face, reached by the wide south stair from the gate plaza, the stair under the entrance pavilion and the side stair + steel ramp opposite the A_W lettering (SITE_Garden AW_*). North of the pavilion a sloping lawn strip with a steep grass bank separates the path from the walkway; south of it a raised bed with a low retaining wall. Geometry designed in the A local frame (Scripts/Geo/zones/zone_gate_alley.py), world XY here. Lower-level solids use absolute z; terrain_pads lower TER_Ground under them to 5.0. 2026-09-26: re-measured from the 070309303 SfM photo-match (see the generator header).
